name: mantis-excel-update
description: Update Mantis issue-tracking Excel workbooks from CSV, including summary rules and optional release staging.

interface.shortDescription: 以 Mantis CSV 更新問題單 Excel。
interface.longDescription: 將 Mantis CSV 更新至既有 Excel，保留歷史、統計與備註規則，並可依 GitHub Release／PR 補待過版版號。
defaultPrompt: Use $mantis-excel-update to update my Mantis issue workbook from the latest CSV.
Use $mantis-excel-update to update the pending-release sheet from GitHub Release and PR evidence.
